digest.component_or_area: Serena MCP server integration and Claude Code tool loading
propositions: Serena symbol tools are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before use, creating friction versus zero-cost tools like grep.
The only available control for tool deferral is the global ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH environment variable (no per-tool or per-server lever exists), settable via .claude/settings.json's env block.
Loading all Serena tool schemas upfront costs ~25k tokens minimum (single server) to ~64k tokens with multiple connected MCP servers, but prevents recurrence of defects from the prior epic.
The change requires a repo-committed .claude/settings.json with a .gitignore negation to track only that file while keeping .claude/ otherwise ignored.
The tradeoff is all-or-nothing global: turning deferral off loads every connected server's schemas, not just Serena's three, so the cost is operator-controlled via their MCP surface, not the repo.
